sourceEvidence.excerpt: first principles possess a peculiar emotional advantage: they suspend the obligation to finish. At the foundational level, every local defect becomes evidence that the architecture must be reconsidered. A failed partnership reveals a governance problem. A difficult interface reveals a conceptual inconsistency. A confused reader reveals that the ontology beneath the prose is not yet stable.
